Google Compute Engine Machine Type n2-standard-4

General-purpose Google Compute Engine machine type n2-standard-4 with 4 vCPU and 16 GB memory. GCE machine type n2-standard-4 is certified for SAP applications on Google Cloud Platform. Available in 40 Google Cloud regions.
